Relative |c_+-2| = 0.047, 0.030, 0.0116, 0.0041, 0.00128 for eps = 0.15, 0.05, 0.015, 0.005, 0.0015. c_-2/eps = 0.881-0.139i, 1.471+0.825i, 1.648+1.156i, 1.6945+1.2489i, 1.7104+1.2809i: it tends to about 1.717+1.295i with a clean O(eps) correction (slope about -4.6-9.2i, consistent between the last two intervals), so the onset is linear. c_+2 is the complex conjugate (real parameters). |c_+-3| stays at 1.4e-44 to 1.6e-44 for every eps, so the imbalance switches on only the top mode, not modes |k|>=r.

Complex imbalance on A2: eps=0.05+0.03i gives relative |c_-2|,|c_+2| = 0.0254, 0.0148; eps=0.005+0.003i gives 0.00322, 0.00181. c_-2/eps = -1.191+2.091i, then -1.854+2.082i; c_+2/eps = -0.354-1.359i, then -0.411-1.511i. Both signs are nonzero and unrelated, as expected without reflection symmetry.
C63d control C1 rerun with this code (R kernel d=1.7, tau=0.55+0.3i, beta=(+0.15,-0.15,q-tau)): relative top 0.0135 / 0.00287, matching their Table 1 (1.4e-2 / 2.9e-3); all modes agree to 1.2e-15.

Outside (C) near the d/2 boundary: O1 (real) and O2 (complex), d=1.3, r=3, alpha=0.62<0.65 (2alpha-d=-0.06), (B) exact. The plain lattice sum diverges there: the unregularized evaluation gives max|c| about 1e102 at truncation depth D=26 and about 1e134 at D=36, i.e. it grows like 10^(3D) with the tail cut-off.

The same outside points by analytic continuation: the leading power of the divergent corner integral is subtracted and added back analytically, everything else unchanged. The continued Xi stays a degree-2 trig polynomial with zero top modes: O1 3.7e-41 (fine 5.1e-50), O2 2.3e-41 / 6.8e-42 (fine 6.1e-50 / 9.1e-51), at the same level as the must-vanish |k|=3 modes. So (C) behaves as a convergence hypothesis only, as the Lemma's analyticity argument predicts.

Checks of the continuation itself. It reproduces the analytically continued closed form of a synthetic quadrant sum outside its convergence region (7.6e-17 at test precision). At the inside point I1 (2alpha-d=0.1), the continued and plain evaluations agree to 8.0e-44, and I1's top modes are 1.3e-44 (continued) and 7.3e-48 (plain, h=1/22).
method: Own code, nothing imported from foundation/ or K_general/. Xi(t) = D S sampled at N = 2r+1 points on a horizontal line and Fourier-transformed; the |k| = r modes, which must vanish by the finite-mode part, set an internal noise floor. S split into right, middle and left parts after reflection; each part is a quadrant sum of U(p)V(p+q)W(q), evaluated as exact head sums, exact Abel-Plana tails (no derivatives, no Bernoulli remainders), and the corner double integral split along the diagonal with tanh-sinh rules matched to the endpoint exponents and Gauss-Legendre panels for the Plana y-integrals. Gamma ratios from an own Bernoulli-polynomial asymptotic series; mpmath.zeta not used. Main runs: 48 digits, D=44, h=1/14, K=26. Every case in (a), (b), W0 and the continued points rerun with dps 54, D 50, h 1/18, K 32, more Gauss nodes and a disjoint set of t-nodes.
validation: Closed-form quadrant sums: 1.6e-55 to 1.1e-52 at fine settings. S(t+1) = S(t) to 4e-18 at low precision. h=1/16, 1/20, 1/24 agree to 48 digits. Main vs fine reruns agree to 5e-44 or better. TN's 50-digit wheel modes reproduced to all 40 printed digits; C63d's R5, G2 and C1 modes to their 1e-15 precision.
caveats: All error bars are empirical (convergence ladders, independent reruns, must-vanish modes); no interval bounds. Very small endpoint exponents (about 0.1) converge slowly in h (a synthetic test reaches only 1.5e-29 at main settings); production cases avoided that regime or were cross-checked. The outside-(C) and continued checks cover only points where 2alpha > d fails, by less than 1. symmetry's sharedq gives at most 8 logical CPUs per node, shared among all jobs, so runs were spread one batch per node over <NODE> and <NODE>.
